title: Marco Pierre White's Crispy Fried Bread & Anchovy Sandwich
originalTitle: Marco Pierre White's Crispy Fried Bread & Anchovy Sandwich
ingredients: 2 slices thick white bloomer or sourdough bread, crusts trimmed
1 tin (2 oz) high-quality Spanish or Italian anchovy fillets in olive oil
2 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil (including the fragrant oil from the anchovy tin) + 1 tbsp butter
1 tbsp finely chopped flat-leaf parsley & freshly cracked black pepper
instructions: Pour the oil from the anchovy tin into a skillet along with 1 tbsp butter over medium heat.
Fry the bread slices in the savory anchovy-butter oil for 2 minutes per side until crisp and golden brown.
Arrange the anchovy fillets neatly across one slice of hot fried bread, sprinkle with chopped parsley, black pepper, and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice, and top with the second slice.
